pins.headline: What applying to med school costs
pins.title: How Much Does It Cost to Apply to Med School? (2027 Fees)
pins.description: The real cost of applying to med school in 2027: MCAT $360, AMCAS $180 plus $48 per school, secondaries up to about $150 each. Worked example for 20 schools and a free budget worksheet.

pins.headline: Before a single secondary
pins.sub: The full cost breakdown + a free budget sheet
pins.title: AMCAS Fees for 20 Schools: $1,092 (Full Cost Breakdown)
pins.description: AMCAS charges $180 for the first school and $48 for each one after, so 20 schools comes to $1,092 before secondaries. See the full med school application budget and a free worksheet.

pins.headline: Budget your med school applications
pins.sub: MCAT, AMCAS, secondaries and interviews, with blanks for your own numbers.
pins.title: Free Med School Application Budget Worksheet
pins.description: A free printable budget worksheet for med school applications with lines for the MCAT, AMCAS, each secondary fee and interview costs. Uses official 2027 AAMC prices.

pins.headline: The cost of applying, line by line
pins.title: Cost of Applying to Medical School: Line by Line
pins.description: Every cost of applying to medical school in one place: test fees, AMCAS, secondaries, interviews and what the AAMC Fee Assistance Program covers. Free printable budget worksheet.

pins.headline: Pre-med money plan
pins.sub: Fill in your school list and see your real total
pins.title: Pre Med Budget: Plan Your Application Costs
pins.description: Plan your pre-med application budget before July hits. Fill in your MCAT date, school count and each secondary fee to see your real total. Free printable worksheet.

pins.headline: MCAT reschedule fees
items: Under 10 days: no changes at all
pins.title: MCAT Reschedule Fees for 2027 (and When You Can't Change)
pins.description: Moving your MCAT date costs more the closer you get! For 2027 the AAMC charges $55 at 60+ days out, $110 at 30 to 59 days and $210 at 10 to 29 days, and nothing can change inside 10 days. Plus the full cost of applying to med school and a free budget worksheet.

pins.quote: Apply for FAP before you pay for anything
pins.headline: The benefits aren't retroactive
pins.sub: What it covers + a free budget sheet
pins.title: AAMC Fee Assistance: Apply Before You Pay Anything
pins.description: If you might qualify for the AAMC Fee Assistance Program, apply first! Benefits aren't retroactive. It covers AMCAS fees for up to 20 schools, drops the MCAT to $145, and adds free Official Prep and MSAR. See what applying to med school really costs, with a free budget worksheet.
